review_text: From the first survey to handover the whole thing was calm and well organised. The shaker doors are beautifully made and the fit around our very un-square walls is faultless.
The media wall completely changed the room. They hid every cable and the walnut is stunning in the evening light.
Really good design work and genuinely helpful advice about the flue. Communication through the portal made it easy to keep track.
Hannah listened properly to how we actually use the space. The walk-in is now the best-organised room in the house.
Second project with Enzo and the standard has not slipped at all. Would not go anywhere else in Leicester.
Excellent joinery and a tidy team. Install ran a few days over but they kept us informed the whole way.
Early days but the care taken over the listed-building constraints has been really reassuring.
